messages:
kevin: 🚨 Seeing a spike in cross-region routing for EU customers — ~3.8% of requests for eu-west are being routed to us-east and then immediately falling back to the tiny quantized variant (rw-compact-v0-q4). Results: OOM/retries -> client 502s and our retry loop count climbs. Sample log: `fallback_loop_detected max_attempts=5 model=rw-compact-v0-q4 region=us-east trace=7a2f...`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-045 routing-anomaly (priority P1) — paging eng-platform and eng-runtime :rotating_light:

marta: I can see the same in routing_events: there are route decisions triggered by the new policy comparator (weight + latency_estimate) that prefers us-east variants when eu pool is at ~95% capacity. Looks like the comparator mistakenly treats "compatible_variant=false" as lower priority rather than forbidden. Query I ran:
```
select timestamp, account_id, src_region, chosen_region, model_variant, reason
from routing_events
where trace_id like '7a2f%'
order by timestamp desc
limit 20;
```

raj: urgent mitigation: flip fallback behavior to fail closed for EU tier customers until we patch the comparator. Proposed CLI override (one-liner):
```
redwood routing override --scope region:eu --policy fallback=deny --reason "INC-2025-045 temporary mitigation"
```
I also suggest pinning enterprise EU customers to model-family `rw-eu-*` for the next 2 hours.

sophie: Adding dashboard panels now: cross-region-reroute-rate, fallback-loop-count, and per-model OOM rate. Link (private): https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/routing/INC-2025-045

kevin: Quick check — is this triggered only for cross-region or also cross-tier? I see a handful of enterprise accounts routed cross-region too.

marta: Good catch. The comparator bug is scoped to the "regional_preference" tree which is used for both tier and region routing. So cross-tier routing got hit as a side-effect.

raj: For immediate safety, I'm patching the routing service to treat `compatible_variant=false` as terminal (no fallback). Patch going out as hotfix: `service/routing: v2.14.3` — rolling restart on eu routing fleet.

ops-bot: Deploy started: service/routing v2.14.3 -> eu-routing-[3 nodes], initiated by raj at 2025-09-10T14:22:40Z

kevin: After the override + hotfix, cross-region reroute rate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.1% in 5m. Fallback-loop metric/alerts cleared. Thank you.

sophie: Notes for console UX: we should add a per-policy toggle "deny cross-region fallback" visible in rollout UI, with a one-click override and clear impact estimate (tokens saved / latency impact). Also show recent policy changes and who toggled them (audit trail).

marta: Action items:
- raj: follow-up PR to comparator to treat `compatible_variant` as a boolean gate, add unit tests (ETA: today EOD)
- sophie: console change to expose the temporary override and audit link (ETA: next sprint)
- kevin: postmortem draft and notify CS about affected customers (ETA: tomorrow morning)

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/478 — includes test vectors and fix for comparator ordering.

kevin: Customer-facing note (short): "We experienced a brief routing incident that caused some EU requests to be processed in a different region, leading to degraded performance for a small subset of requests. We applied a hotfix and temporary policy to prevent cross-region fallback while we complete the fix. No user data was exposed." Will share final postmortem after RCA.

sophie: Also recommend we add a simulation mode in the console for rollout policies — run a policy against a recorded traffic sample and show predicted routing distribution and fallbacks before flipping to prod.

marta: Confirming logs and traces retained; I'll attach sample traces to the postmortem. Closing incident once postmortem is posted.

kevin: Closing notes: incident resolved, mitigations in place, follow-ups tracked. Great cross-team response :clap:
